profile.headline: Software Engineer at NCBI
profile.summary: I am an accomplished full-stack software engineer and collaborative team member passionate about learning new technologies, tackling challenges, and developing creative solutions to complex problems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-Stack Senior Software Engineer developing and maintaining the NIH Submission System using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, ReactJS, and Microsoft SQL Server. Responsible for developing and enhancing applications across the full stack, from backend business logic and database design to REST APIs and frontend components.
Contribute to application quality, reliability, and maintainability through automated testing, code reviews, and ongoing technology and dependency upgrades. Collaborate with engineering team members and product owners to understand requirements, evaluate solutions, and deliver new functionality.
As part of a two-person engineering team, helped develop the PubMed Central Quality Improvement (QI) system, supporting PMC's transition from traditional quality assurance toward working with publishers to improve the quality of future submissions.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · SASS · jQuery · React.js

company.name: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) / Guidehouse

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack Senior Software Engineer focused on architecting, developing and testing new applications written in Python/Django designed to improve author services, editorial experience and online purchases.
Developed a book editing platform that helps authors obtain editing assistance, from designing their book cover to fully publishing their book. This provides authors a one stop shop for their new books while generating more revenue for the company. Refactored company's search engine to become more user friendly. This allowed users to find book reviews very easily by entering the author's first or last name, ISBN number, book title, etc. which improved the user experience in the site. Worked on migrating the company’s codebase from Python 2 to Python 3 and from Django 1.8 to 2.2. Created an automated CI pipeline using CircleCI. This allowed us to test every commit and deploy to production many times per week.
Software development included but not limited to maintaining and developing new features for in-house CMS, writing REST APIs with Django Rest Framework, unit tests using Pytest and maintaining AWS infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · SASS · Vue.js · jQuery · ElasticSearch · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon EC2 · Amazon S3 · Amazon EBS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack Software Engineer focused on creating applications to contribute to ORCAS' vision of using strong science and simple technology to cultivate resilience at work and in life. Developed MoodHacker a mobile web application (Python/Django/PostgreSQL), that helps users track, understand, and improve their mood, and reduce depression symptoms. Helped to develop (as part of a 3-person engineering team) MindSet, a mobile web application that activates new behaviors to improve lifestyle habits. Software development included but not limited to maintaining and developing new features using Python/Django, writing APIs with Django Rest Framework, and maintaining the company's open source projects. Front-end development in Backbone and writing SASS rules for CSS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Help to maintain and develop new features for the in-house CMS written in Python/Django. Developed an application to redeem vouchers and wrote backend functionality for delivering online newsletters from all newspapers properties that are part of CMG.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed company’s new video production system (as part of 3-person engineering team), an application that allows an easy way for trainers to upload videos and for administrators to create video collections, review and approve videos. Wrote the backend functionality in Node/Express/Mongoose, to deliver content into a variety of Learning Management Systems. Collaborated with various team members to create RESTful endpoints to deliver content information. Developed scripts in Python to migrate data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB. Software development included data modeling in Mongoose, writing backend code in Node, front-end programming in AngularJS and unit tests using Mocha and Chai.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Architected, developed and maintained self-management mobile web applications written in Python/Django designed to improve physical and emotional well-being. Developed technical solutions both directly and as part of the technology team. Persistently researched, tested, and incorporated effective approaches and new technologies. Made recommendations on which technologies to include in ORCAS's technology stack. Acted as a technical consultant for vendors. Software development included but not limited to writing database models, views, APIs, unit tests, front-end programming in Backbone, and deploying sites. Managed projects, wrote specifications, and ensured steady progress.

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained applications for SELCO's public site and intranet written in .NET/C#, ASP, and Symitar which is their core application. Some of these applications included SELCO's service request system, employee referral system, and incentive system.
Developed and designed an automated rate management system written in C# and SQL Server. Helped accomplish a seamless transition from an inefficient manual system to the new automated system for SELCO's Loan and Saving rates and pricing sheet.

positions.title: Computer Programmer II, Web Developer
positions.description: Developed multimedia health-based web applications using PHP, MySQL, CSS.

projects.description: Worked on a team to create a CMS that supports the delivery and management of streaming videos. Collaborated with various team members to create RESTful endpoints to deliver content information and securely stream training content to a variety of platforms.
